disposition.summary: Dense-number storage v1 and Values-first publication v2 both fail the predeclared performance gate. Production is restored to the original baseline. Only baseline-compatible semantic and snapshot regressions are retained; neither runtime candidate ships.
disposition.acceptance_boundary: Candidate native coverage, baseline selected Test262 replays, and final restored-source checks are separate evidence. None constitutes full release acceptance or a new full-suite Test262 publication.

dates.date_policy: The 20261030 filenames name the experiment cohort. Final validation and durable evidence assembly cross UTC midnight; their receipts retain actual dates.

measurement_contract.gate: Declared before measurement: above 5% slowdown in both balanced orders triggers an opposite-order confirmation; reproducible material regression rejects, regardless of allocation savings or other wins.
measurement_contract.original_17: The original ordinary scripts and separately derived strict retained-call modules are distinct boundaries. The eighteenth ordinary numeric-join-fallback diagnostic is outside the original 17; it has no retained-call result.
measurement_contract.ordinary_boundary: Unchanged ordinary script execution through runtime_baseline; setup and compilation phase diagnostics are reported separately from measured invocation execution.
measurement_contract.retained_boundary: Derived strict module exported calls through compiler_precompiled_baseline, with native admission, setup and module initialization outside the call timer. This is a diagnostic excluded from ordinary cohorts.
measurement_contract.startup_boundary: Fresh frozen scriptw CLI processes execute `scriptw run startup.js`: ten checked process warmups, then 21 measured whole-process samples per product round. Startup is separate from runtime_baseline ordinary invocations and retained exported calls.
measurement_contract.samples: Each repetition uses eight product rounds, ten warmups and 21 measured samples per round. Original raw samples, per-process command receipts, output digests, resources and exact artifact identities are archived.
measurement_contract.no_external_parity_claim: No V8/Scriptc parity, global chart update, full conformance claim, or published speed score.

native_scheduling.compilation_policy: all quota-bound inherited parent CPUs when idle; one free CPU while native targets run; the build tree expands to the parent budget once every native wrapper has exited

Actual memory.swap.max=max and memory.oom.group=0; this is not the local 4 GiB/no-swap/grouped-OOM policy.

Candidate bytes, retained image/native/Wasm hashes and preparation phases are in each archive artifact-metadata.json. Numeric fallback bytes/manifest are under raw/numeric-fallback-fixture/. Frozen native, executable, and Wasm payloads are deliberately excluded; their identities remain recorded.

candidates.reason: Ordinary mixed joins slow in all four balanced groups (+8.685%, +13.266%, +11.967%, +4.986%). Retained-object calls also slow (+3.308%, +5.779%, +11.998%, +4.916%). Faster ordinary retained-object runs and fewer private buffers do not satisfy the control gate.
candidates.production_change: Explicit DenseNumbers mode 4 and semantic ABI 41; COUNT is the occupied numeric prefix. Presence storage stays shared empty until an admitted interior hole requires a bitmap. Numeric/descriptor fallback and GC roots remain correctness obligations.

source_provenance.candidate_source: raw/implementation-v1/ retains the experimental source and tests as inert text.
source_provenance.supplement_reason: The original v1 directory filter omits a source copy under src/runtime_artifact/cache. Its change remains in the original compile-inputs.patch; the final-validation archive additionally preserves the complete source text checked against the original compile-input digest. All seventeen v1 and five v2 compiled-input copies are accounted for.

mechanism.result: Encoded-Wasm/source proof removes 8,192 private presence-array allocations and 65,536 payload bytes per original retained-objects invocation, excluding GC headers. This is allocation/liveness reasoning, not live-heap or RSS telemetry.
mechanism.memory_result: Sampled ordinary retained-object RSS is essentially flat; both products retain 16 MiB GC capacity. No RSS reduction is claimed.

timing.scope: same-machine default-feature diagnostic; original ordinary scripts and separately derived strict retained-call modules; numeric join fallback is a separate diagnostic, not part of the original 17 cases; no V8/Scriptc parity claim
timing.round_raw_paths: Each analysis products[].raw points to the full samples and original command receipt in its own archive directory. Confirmation raw paths are relative to raw/confirmation/.
timing.aggregation: For each product, take the median of all 84 measured samples in a repetition; each balanced group uses 42 samples. Percent is (candidate/baseline - 1)*100. Rounded summary values only; full samples and precision remain in the archive.

primary_phase_and_memory.scope: Sampled process RSS and whole-child high-water RSS include different lifetimes; GC capacity is reserved capacity. None measures live JavaScript bytes or per-call allocation bytes.

native_inspection.scope: Inert inspection of exact frozen NativeR bytes. Static partial-path counts and disassembly size do not establish retired instructions, cycles, or a timing cause.

construction_isolation.scope: Whole ordinary lifetime stage diagnostics; not an isolated subtraction score or original17 result.
construction_isolation.interpretation: Construction-heavy whole lifetimes slow by 3.666%/6.242%, while 128-join lifetimes change by -1.974%/-5.673%. These diagnostics identify construction/publication as a refinement target; subtracting totals would not isolate a causal per-operation cost.

candidates.reason: Retained joins remain slower after opposite-order confirmation: 1,024 joins +9.4/+11.1/+4.7/+24.0%, singleton +9.4/+12.8/+15.4/+1.0%, empty +3.4/+12.6/+10.4/+7.8%. The initial ordinary mixed-array gain (-2.2/-1.9%) does not reproduce (+8.1/+1.0%).
candidates.production_change: Baseline ABI 40 with only objects/packed_array_index/values.rs changed: classify Values readiness once, skip numeric attempts for existing Values, and join successful promotion into one common Values writer.

candidates.native_interpretation: The valid already-Values static partial dispatch shrinks from 65 to 15 listed instructions, ten to three branches and three to one classification dereference stages. Default-data publication shrinks 9,950→9,780 bytes with a 272-byte entry frame; descriptor publication grows 21,632→21,688 bytes and 256→272 entry-stack bytes. NativeR grows 4,080 bytes. These counts establish emitted structure, not cycles or speed.

normalized_join_comparison.scope: Address-normalized disassembly identity only; instruction-fetch or placement effects have not been measured.
normalized_join_comparison.normalization: Select objdump lines beginning with a hexadecimal address and colon; remove the leading instruction address; replace numeric addresses immediately before symbolic <targets> with the unchanged symbol. Register operands, constants, offsets, mnemonics and symbolic target offsets remain unchanged.

program_and_join_identity.placement_observation: array_packed_join moves from address modulo 64 = 0 to 32. The observed cache-line position shift is not causal proof; instruction-fetch, placement and dynamic execution remain unmeasured.

formatting_and_source_checks.result: Both candidate formatting comparisons retain the same eighteen pre-existing full-format failures and zero newly failing files. Source guards pass separately; product-graph and source ownership checks are archived.

final_formatting.result: The final cargo fmt check fails on exactly the same eighteen pre-existing files, with no new failures.

The semantic wrapper executes the JavaScript fixture in both strict and sloppy modes; the separate graph snapshot regression passes. This is focused acceptance for the retained tests, with no transfer of the rejected candidates' wide native coverage.
